# Hlith run artifact reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_artifact_doc.py from src/hlith/hlith.schema.json. Do not edit by hand; tests/test_artifact_doc.py fails when this file differs from the generator output. -->

Schema `urn:hlith:run-artifact:cli-2` (HlithRunArtifact). Every object below marked closed rejects unknown keys: a renamed or new field is a schema change, never silent. A UI should read this file together with a real artifact you produce.

## Outcome lattice

`decide()` (src/hlith/types.py) reads ONLY `obligations`: landing needs every verdict HELD and at least one account-bound obligation; otherwise the first present class in the order REFUTED > NOT_DERIVED > UNVERIFIED sets the exit status. `delta_rel`, `timings` and `graph` are never read by it.

| exit_status | class | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | landed | every obligation HELD and at least one of them consumed the effect account (account_bound) |
| 4 | boundary | the run could not be confined or set up (sandbox, worker, argument errors): nothing was judged |
| 10 | refused: REFUTED | at least one obligation REFUTED: a concrete witness (pre vs post) or a claim violation |
| 11 | refused: NOT_DERIVED | no REFUTED, at least one NOT_DERIVED: the checker could not derive or model something it needed (also: all HELD but none account-bound) |
| 12 | refused: UNVERIFIED | no REFUTED/NOT_DERIVED, at least one UNVERIFIED: a check could not run or ran out (empty impacted test slice, timeout, import failure); also a required proposer manifest missing/invalid |

### Obligation verdicts

| verdict | what it means for a UI |
|---|---|
| `held` | this obligation's bounded check found no difference on what it explored (see evidence.explored / unexplored). Per obligation, bounded: NOT a proof of the change |
| `refuted` | a witness exists: a concrete input with pre != post (witness), or a claim violation (the stage did something outside its own claim; labelled, not a behavioural witness) |
| `not-derived` | the checker's limit: it could not build or model the obligation (stop_reason names the construct). Says nothing about the change being wrong |
| `unverified` | the check could not complete (stop_reason): not evidence either way |

If `--redo-inflight` repeated a call whose completion was indeterminate, `redo_inflight=true` and `redone_turn` identify that operator-authorized retry. ## Main records

### `obligation` (closed)

One claim and its verdict. `witness` carries the REFUTED evidence (a call you can paste: input, pre outcome, post outcome; or the claim violation text); the schema does not forbid it on other verdicts, so a UI must key on `verdict`, not on witness presence; `stop_reason` explains NOT_DERIVED / UNVERIFIED; `evidence` says what was explored and, as important, what was NOT (`unexplored`). Format-2 artifacts may also carry `witness_call` and, only when a recorded call adapts, `witness_record` (schema version 1) on a REFUTED obligation. These optional runtime fields are not part of the closed v1 schema table below.

| field | required | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | string |  |
| `target_symbol` | yes | string |  |
| `claim` | yes | string |  |
| `verdict` | yes | enum "held" \| "refuted" \| "not-derived" \| "unverified" |  |
| `stop_reason` | yes | string \| null |  |
| `witness` | yes | string \| null |  |
| `evidence` | yes | null \| evidence |  |
| `provenance` | yes | null \| provenance |  |
| `account_id` | yes | null \| string | obligation.account_id: the effect account this obligation was derived from |

### `acct_opaque_caller_guard` (closed)

An unchanged unsupported entry guard dominating an impacted caller; every call site below it is checked under both polarities, so it does not block.

### `acct_index_cache_provenance` (closed)

Cache hits vs uncached files for the account build (on the wrapper).

Schema: Per-build indexed-file totals of effect index cache. Python side: EffectAccount.index_cache_stats, a separate attribute excluded from EffectAccount.to_dict(); the CLI writes it here as the artifact key effect_account.index_cache_provenance. Lives on the report wrapper, OUTSIDE the account dict, so account_id and account_sha256 do not change between cold and warm runs. REQUIRED on every report; {0,0} when no indexing ran (failed/no-change).

### `delta_rel_item` (closed)

Advisory relational Z3 result for one modified callable: verdict PROVED\|COUNTEREXAMPLE\|UNMODELED, `proof_tier` and `assumptions` (a conditional proof's premises). A COUNTEREXAMPLE only seeds the differential; nothing here decides.

Schema: delta_rel: non-gating Z3 delta-relational evidence for one modified callable. decide() never reads it; PROVED does not replace the repository test slice. Only COUNTEREXAMPLE also seeds run_differential.

| field | required | type | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | yes | string | qualified name of the modified callable |
| `verdict` | yes | enum "PROVED" \| "COUNTEREXAMPLE" \| "UNMODELED" |  |
| `reason` | yes | string | whitespace-collapsed, <=300 chars |
| `provenance` | yes | object (closed) \| object (closed) |  |
| `witness_inputs` | yes | array of object |  |
| `fragment_notes` | yes | string | one line: what the grammar covers / why UNMODELED |
| `proof_tier` | no | enum "unconditional" \| "conditional" \| "none" | : unconditional = numeric-fragment Z3 proof over the whole annotated domain, no unverified premise about other code; conditional = UF mode, valid only under `assumptions`, must never be admitted alone; none = COUNTEREXAMPLE/UNMODELED (nothing proved). PROVED <=> unconditional\|conditional. Non-gating: decide() never reads it. Optional until every emitter pass carries it , then required. |
| `assumptions` | no | array of string | : premises a PROVED stands on, in emitter order (UF: the callee premise first). conditional: at least one; none: empty; unconditional: empty unless declared deltas are taken as given. Present only with proof_tier. |

| proof_tier | meaning |
|---|---|
| `unconditional` | Z3 proof over the whole annotated domain with no unverified premise (numeric fragment) |
| `conditional` | UF mode: valid only under `assumptions`; never admits anything alone |
| `none` | COUNTEREXAMPLE or UNMODELED: nothing proved |

## Real examples

Run `hlith check ... --artifact-out DIR` to produce a real artifact. This reference describes every field; example artifacts are not included in this source snapshot.
